artifact_range_corrupt_object.detail: object 00…01 content does not match digest
artifact_range_corrupt_object.recovery_path: nothing is read past a digest mismatch; the operation stops before writing
artifact_range_corrupt_object.user_action: the stored object does not match its digest; restore it from a backup or discard the checkpoint that names it

artifact_range_missing_object.recovery_path: the operation ran and reported failure; read its output and change the command or the code before running it again

budget_tool_calls.recovery_path: the run suspended with its partial evidence; resume with StartTask and a larger budget
budget_tool_calls.user_action: raise `max_tool_calls` (used 40 of 40) and resume, or narrow the goal

budget_turns.recovery_path: the run suspended with its partial evidence; resume with StartTask and a larger budget
budget_turns.user_action: raise `max_turns` (used 12 of 12) and resume, or narrow the goal

change_apply_not_projected.detail: `change.apply` is not in this turn's tool projection; declare what it needs in `plan.update` (files in expected_files, effects in protected_effects) or find it with tool.search, and call it once it is projected
change_apply_not_projected.recovery_path: declare the files (expected_files) or the effect (protected_effects) in `plan.update`, or activate the tool with tool.search; call it once it is projected

change_apply_unknown_outcome.recovery_path: the resumed run reconciles the call against the effect ledger and the target before anything else runs; it never replays the effect
change_apply_unknown_outcome.user_action: check the target of the effect and record the outcome with ReconcileToolCall (EFFECT_CONFIRMED or EFFECT_ABSENT) when the Core cannot tell

dispatch_not_journaled.recovery_path: the dispatch was not journaled so nothing ran; call again

dispatch_stale_lease.recovery_path: the operation did not run; call again once the infrastructure is back
dispatch_stale_lease.user_action: check the terminal broker and the workspace are reachable

fs_write_outside_scope.detail: path is outside the task scope
fs_write_outside_scope.recovery_path: the effect did not happen; the run continues without it
fs_write_outside_scope.user_action: widen the task's lease or profile if the effect is wanted

git_push_approval_denied.recovery_path: the effect did not happen; the run continues without it

git_push_approval_pending.recovery_path: the run waits at the approval; approving once runs the effect once
git_push_approval_pending.user_action: resolve the approval bound to this intent (ResolveApproval); the same call re-enters once it is approved

invalid_arguments.recovery_path: call again with arguments that fit the tool's schema, or a tool that exists

lease_lost.recovery_path: the stale owner stopped at a safe boundary; the current lease holder resumes with StartTask
lease_lost.user_action: the session lease moved from generation 2 to 3 (owner cli:shell-2); the new owner resumes the run

loop_no_progress.recovery_path: the run suspended after consecutive turns without progress; resume with StartTask
loop_no_progress.user_action: steer the task or narrow the goal

loop_question_pending.recovery_path: the run waits at the question boundary
loop_question_pending.user_action: answer the question (RespondToQuestion); the run resumes from the answer

loop_repair_escalated.detail: repair escalated for test.run:FAILED: same failure 3 times (3 attempt(s))
loop_repair_escalated.recovery_path: the repair loop stopped by policy; resume with StartTask and a steer
loop_repair_escalated.user_action: read the attempt history and steer, or return the task to work with a new hypothesis

loop_scope_fail_closed.detail: scope expansion to src/x needs a decision; headless resolution is FAIL_CLOSED

provider_auth_rejected.recovery_path: resume with StartTask once the provider accepts the credential
provider_auth_rejected.user_action: the provider rejected the credential; configure it again (ConfigureProvider)

provider_connect_failed.recovery_path: resume with StartTask; the interrupted attempt is recorded and not repeated
provider_connect_failed.user_action: check the provider endpoint is reachable

provider_model_revoked.recovery_path: resume with StartTask on an eligible model
provider_model_revoked.user_action: choose a model the registry allows, or lift the pin

provider_none_configured.recovery_path: resume with StartTask once a provider serves the model
provider_none_configured.user_action: configure a provider (ConfigureProvider) or pick a served model

provider_other.recovery_path: resume with StartTask; the failed attempt is recorded and not repeated

provider_rate_limited.recovery_path: resume with StartTask after the provider's retry window

provider_stream_timeout.recovery_path: resume with StartTask; the interrupted attempt is recorded with its cost unknown

restart_awaiting_answer.detail: runtime restarted while the task awaited an answer
restart_awaiting_answer.recovery_path: the run continues from the answer
restart_awaiting_answer.user_action: answer the question and resume with StartTask

restart_awaiting_approval.detail: runtime restarted while the task awaited approval
restart_awaiting_approval.recovery_path: the same approval, bound to the same intent, is still open; approving once runs the effect once
restart_awaiting_approval.user_action: resolve the open approval and resume with StartTask

restart_executing.detail: runtime restarted with 2 proposed tool call(s) not yet run
restart_executing.recovery_path: the run continues from its last recorded boundary; nothing is repeated

restart_reconciling.detail: runtime restarted with 1 tool call(s) in flight
restart_reconciling.recovery_path: the resumed run reconciles each unknown outcome against the ledger and the target before anything else runs
restart_reconciling.user_action: resume with StartTask to reconcile the calls, or record their outcome with ReconcileToolCall first

restart_turn_start.detail: runtime restarted while the task was running
restart_turn_start.recovery_path: the run continues from its last recorded boundary; nothing is repeated

shell_exec_broker_unreachable.recovery_path: the operation did not run; call again once the infrastructure is back
shell_exec_broker_unreachable.user_action: check the terminal broker and the workspace are reachable

shell_exec_cancelled.recovery_path: the run stopped at a safe boundary; resume with StartTask to continue

shell_exec_nonzero_exit.recovery_path: the operation ran and reported failure; read its output and change the command or the code before running it again

shell_exec_timeout.recovery_path: run it again with a larger timeout_ms, or split the command; a process that timed out was killed and left no result to trust

store_integrity.recovery_path: nothing is applied past an integrity failure
store_integrity.user_action: the store's record does not verify; recovery refuses to proceed past it

store_object_mismatch.recovery_path: nothing is applied past an integrity failure
store_object_mismatch.user_action: the store's record does not verify; recovery refuses to proceed past it

store_sequence_conflict.recovery_path: another writer moved the aggregate; the operation re-reads and retries

store_sqlite.recovery_path: the write did not land; the operation may be retried
store_sqlite.user_action: check the profile directory is writable and the disk has space

store_stale_lease.recovery_path: a stale owner cannot advance state; the current owner resumes with StartTask
store_stale_lease.user_action: re-acquire the session lease (AcquireSessionLease) or let the current owner continue

test_run_failed.recovery_path: the operation ran and reported failure; read its output and change the command or the code before running it again

unknown_tool.recovery_path: call again with arguments that fit the tool's schema, or a tool that exists
